summary.text: Michael Brennan is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 115, Cumberland County, representing Portland.
The page lists committee service on Appropriations and Financial Affairs and Education and Cultural Affairs.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Michael Brennan's education as FSU, USM, UNE (B.A. Education, M.A. Muskie School of Public Service, MSW, 1975, 1989, 1994).
The page lists Michael Brennan's occupation as Licensed Clinical Social Worker.
Michael Brennan lives in Portland and has served 8 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
The page also lists 3 sessions in the Senate.
Committee assignments listed: Appropriations and Financial Affairs (member); Education and Cultural Affairs (member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Joan Martay, 2 children, 1 grandchild.
